name: RfcWfmReconciliationProposalEngine
input: one complete non-noop ImportRun source set plus current domain snapshots from LLD-02/03/05; for chronology recovery the same proposals are generated but acceptance remains locked by recovery review
rfc_flow: for each conflict-free canonical RFC observation resolve exact RFC identity through LLD-03; similar labels never adopt
if missing, propose rfc_create_or_adopt preserving exact rfc_no; if existing manual/provisional, propose exact adoption/source provenance without replacing rfc_id

compute field-level accepted-source candidate changes against LLD-03 current RFC source projection using usable source chronology/precedence; missing/blank/unknown never clears recognized truth unless field contract allows

recognized terminal status entry/correction is high-risk rfc_source_projection; acceptance invokes LLD-03 RfcImportMutationService.apply_accepted_source_projection so terminal evidence and pending cascade proposal commit atomically while cascade execution remains separate

Customer Account Number first through LLD-02 governed account-code matching/review semantics, then name only as descriptive CandidateResult; emit rfc_customer_reconciliation only as reviewed proposal and never silently assign/merge

run SR-candidate extraction over RFC Summary and create sr_rfc_link_candidate proposals only against existing exact SR identities; direct target resolves through current LLD-03 governing root at acceptance time
wfm_flow: for each conflict-free canonical WFM observation resolve exact Task No. through LLD-05 and exact parent RFC through LLD-03
when RFC is missing, emit wfm_provisional_rfc proposal using exact RFC identity and bounded WFM hints; never fabricate SR/hierarchy

active nonterminal WFM under missing/provisional RFC also emits separate high-risk wfm_provisional_eligibility proposal; its acceptance invokes LLD-03 RFC lifecycle authority and records a visibly wfm_provisional implement-eligibility projection only when stronger Enhanced RFC evidence does not block it; historical Complete/Plan Cancel never emits this proposal
emit wfm_create_or_adopt and independent wfm_source_projection proposals under LLD-05 while preserving exact Task identity and owner

material valid source-plan difference may emit wfm_plan_reconciliation; accepting provider source projection persists source-plan evidence, while accepting an operational-plan change is a separate LLD-05 action and Objective regrouping remains separate again
query LLD-05 activity-lineage/conflict reader for same-lineage overlapping active attempt evidence and emit wfm_competing_attempt_review rather than invent retry/distinct-work classification
only when owning RFC Summary produced no valid SR candidate may WFM Task Name produce SR-link candidates; precedence is computed per owning RFC context, not row order

sr_candidate_parser.strong: token boundary + case-insensitive SR or TT label + optional ASCII whitespace + exactly eight ASCII digits + token boundary
sr_candidate_parser.weak: isolated exactly eight ASCII digits not adjacent to another digit and not recognized as a Gregorian date token under YYYYMMDD, DDMMYYYY or MMDDYYYY validation
rules: substrings of longer numeric/alphanumeric identifiers are excluded
candidate parser never creates an SR
multiple distinct existing SR matches may produce independent proposals
duplicate textual mentions of the same candidate collapse with provenance count

proposal_binding: read domain targets through stable snapshots for proposal calculation
compute base_state_token from exact immutable target IDs, relevant revisions/current projection evidence/hierarchy/plan locks and dependency generations
compute proposal fingerprint from source observation IDs/field hashes/change set/profile IDs/base target identities, excluding transient UI/order/time
persist one proposal per smallest independently committable/reviewable target mutation
proposal creation mutates no domain authority

for recovery_required runs the exact same proposal rows are published for inspection but their acceptance gate is the latest exact import_recovery_review authorization rather than a mutable flag on the proposal
acceptance_rule: Before acceptance, owning command opens one LLD-01 UnitOfWork, recomputes current base-state token/proposal eligibility and any recovery authorization, inserts one outer command receipt before receipt-FK children, invokes exactly the owning LLD-02/03/05 service(s), inserts accepted disposition/audit in the same UoW, and commits. Token/recovery mismatch fails closed without rewriting proposal evidence.
auto_accept: RFC_WFM_AUTO_ACCEPT_V1 contains no mutation classes; therefore every domain-changing RFC/WFM proposal is operator-reviewed in Beta 1.0.
